about: Announcement month (YYYY-MM, or YYYY) and category of every camera model in the dataset, by its make and model as the dataset names them (raw.pixls.us names, and EXIF names normalized for other sources), for scripts/dataset.py. From general knowledge, some checked against press releases (2026-10-11); confidence says how sure. Where a body was shown in development before its launch, the note gives both dates.
